			has_building = ceramic_tile_workshops_4
			aub_can_upgrade_to_ceramic_tile_workshops_5_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = ceramic_tile_workshops_4
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = ceramic_tile_workshops_5 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
}

# ceramics_dragon_kiln_1: 4 frozen upgrade edge(s)
